WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(CASE WHEN f.rebrate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate IS NOT NULL
             THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) as distinct_orders
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
with_window AS (
  SELECT 
    avg_ratio,
    distinct_orders,
    AVG(distinct_orders) OVER () as avg_order_count
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  SUM(distinct_orders) as sum_of_counts,
  AVG(distinct_orders - avg_order_count) as avg_excess
FROM with_window
WHERE distinct_orders > avg_order_count
